About The Role
 In this role, you will work as a Senior Manual QA Engineer on large-scale corporate systems supporting grants and expert management within a European public-sector environment.
You will focus on functional, regression, integration, UAT, and end-to-end testing, working closely with Business Analysts and development teams to validate complex business processes and interconnected systems.
 Responsibilities
Define test plans, test cases, scenarios, scope, and priorities
Review user stories and acceptance criteria, validating business logic, dependencies, and edge cases
Prepare and manage complex test data
Apply exploratory testing, equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, and other test design techniques
Perform functional, regression, integration, UAT, and end-to-end testing
Validate complete submission lifecycles and cross-system data consistency
Track TEST, INT, and PREPROD environments, deployments, availability, and downtime
Capture test evidence, logs, screenshots, and results
Create, prioritize, and track defects with full traceability in Jira
Analyze application logs and backend data to investigate issues
Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, developers, and support teams
 Requirements
University degree corresponding to EQF Level 7, typically a Master’s degree or equivalent
10+ years of professional IT experience
Strong knowledge of manual software testing principles and test design techniques
Hands-on experience with functional, regression, integration, UAT, and end-to-end testing
Strong experience working with user stories and acceptance criteria
Experience with exploratory testing, equivalence partitioning, and boundary value analysis
Experience with Jira and Zephyr for test and defect management
API testing experience with SoapUI
Strong SQL skills using Oracle SQL Developer for test data preparation and backend validation
Experience working with XML and structured data using XML Notepad, Notepad++, or similar tools
Experience with log analysis using Kibana
Experience with JMeter for performance testing
Basic Selenium knowledge for test execution/support
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Familiarity with ChatGPT or other Generative AI tools for test case optimization
Knowledge of grant and audit business processes will be a strong advantage
Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills
English proficiency at B2 level or higher; French will be a plus
